SUPPLY AGREEMENT

This Supply Agreement is entered into on 11 April 2025 between Nilgiri Packaging
Private Limited, Coimbatore (hereinafter "the Supplier") and Trident Foods
Private Limited, Chennai (hereinafter "the Customer").

1. SUPPLY
The Supplier shall supply to the Customer the packaging materials described in the
schedule at the prices stated therein.

2. PAYMENT
The Customer shall pay each invoice within sixty days of the date of delivery. Prices
are exclusive of applicable taxes.

3. TERM AND RENEWAL
The initial term is twelve months. This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for
successive twelve month periods unless either party gives written notice of
non-renewal not less than one hundred and twenty days before the end of the then
current term.

4. ASSIGNMENT
The Supplier shall not assign or transfer this Agreement without the prior written
consent of the Customer. The Customer may assign this Agreement to any affiliate or
successor without restriction and without notice to the Supplier.

5. TERMINATION
The Customer may terminate this Agreement at any time without assigning any reason
by giving thirty days written notice to the Supplier.

6. MODIFICATION
The Customer reserves the right to amend the specifications and these terms at any
time at its sole discretion, and continued supply after notice of any change shall
constitute acceptance.

7. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any dispute shall be referred to a sole arbitrator appointed by mutual agreement of
the parties. The seat of arbitration shall be Chennai.

8. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at Chennai
shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
